page.overview:
What is Atium?

Atium is a metal that has the allomantic effect to see into another person's future. Atium is the metallic form of the god Ruin, and is considered one of the two God metals, the other being Lerasium. Atium was originally thought to be the final, tenth metal and then it was later believed to be but one of the sixteen metals but both of these ideas were eventually disproved.
